hook: Five words got John Nash into Princeton.

beats.say: In February nineteen forty eight, a Carnegie Tech professor recommended a nineteen year old to Princeton. After two sentences of paperwork came five words: he is a mathematical genius.
The student was John Nash. At Princeton, he went on to write a twenty eight page thesis that defined the Nash equilibrium.
On November sixteenth, nineteen forty nine, Solomon Lefschetz, who had received the letter, communicated Nash's note to the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
